Can you tell me weather in India?

Sure, Piyusha! India’s weather varies a lot across the country. In the north and central plains, you’ll find hot, humid summers from March to May, a monsoon season with heavy rains from June to September, and cool, dry winters from November to February. The southern states stay warmer year‑round, with a rainy season that starts a bit earlier, around May. Coastal areas get tropical storms and cyclones mainly between June and November. If you’re planning a trip, the best time to visit most places is from December to March when the weather is milder and drier.
